current.learner: to pass something you have, real or not real, over to another person.
examples: when the living fell, it was given elsewhere

senses.reader_said: The learner line renders concrete or abstract as real or not real, and not real means imaginary, which the gloss does not say and which the example itself (a living, a real church post) contradicts; the example and the null verdict are fine.
